recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It resolves the remaining current-build contradiction while preserving the OperationDefinition model; any future change to affectsState behavior for persisted MeasureReport resources should be handled as a separate work-group decision across both $evaluate-measure and $evaluate.
issue_request: FHIR-16850 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked to resolve contradictory $evaluate-measure idempotency wording by documenting that the operation is not unconditionally idempotent because measure evaluation creates a MeasureReport result.
initial_application: SVN 14857, imported as git commit 3f103525db9991ead6654bc36bc502faab62b022, applied the issue by clarifying the Measure operation source: whether the operation affects server state depends on whether the generated MeasureReport is persisted, and GET can be used when it is not persisted. That guidance remains in the current OperationDefinition source.
additional_context: The Measure resource is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source still had stale clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html prose saying the operation was idempotent and that GET was used because of idempotency. Later FHIR-37571 deprecated $evaluate-measure and introduced $evaluate with matching persistence-dependent guidance, so a narrow narrative alignment was safer than changing the operation definitions. Focused Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Changed source/clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html to replace the unconditional Idempotent property with persistence-dependent state-effect guidance and to explain that the GET examples assume the server does not persist generated MeasureReport resources.
source_changes: source/clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html: replaced the Idempotent property with Affects State guidance tied to generated MeasureReport persistence.
source/clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html: updated the GET example note so GET is conditional on non-persistence rather than justified by idempotency.

related_jiras.note: Deprecated $evaluate-measure and introduced $evaluate with matching persistence-dependent operation guidance, supporting narrative alignment rather than a broader operation-definition rewrite.
